title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
reason: This book is directly aligned with my interests in behavioral economics and understanding human nature. Sapiens explores how humans evolved, our cognitive capabilities, and the economic and social systems we've built—all core topics in behavioral economics. As someone studying behavioral economics and working in software/AI, understanding the foundations of human behavior and history is crucial. The 5-star rating and in-stock availability make it an excellent choice. At £54.23, it's a solid investment in learning material that bridges my academic interests with practical applications in economics and technology.
